2609.26025.title: MICRO: Multi-Fidelity Active Search for Severe Error Discovery
2609.26025.paper_summary: Human feedback can vary in cost and informativeness. Strong feedback can reveal severe errors but is costly, so cheaper quality ratings can help decide which items to annotate. We propose MICRO (Multi-Fidelity Impact Clustered Rollout), an active search framework that allocates a shared budget to these feedback types to maximise confirmed severe error discoveries. MICRO jointly models ratings and annotation losses conditional on item features to steer acquisition. It clusters acquisitions by their predicted impact on severity probabilities to select diverse candidates, then uses rollout to estimate their discovery value. Experiments on WMT20 English-German show that ratings improve both loss reconstruction and severity prediction. MICRO achieves the highest mean discovery count across four budget and rating cost settings, with similar performance to adapted MF-ENS in one and significant gains over all six comparison policies, including two rollout controls, in the other three $(p<.001)$.
2609.26025.paper_summary_zh: 人類反饋的成本和資訊量可能有所不同。強烈的反饋能揭示嚴重錯誤，但成本高昂，因此較便宜的質量評分可以幫助決定哪些項目需要標註。 我們提出了 MICRO（多保真度影響聚類滾動），這是一個主動搜尋框架，將共享預算分配給這些反饋類型，以最大化確認的嚴重錯誤發現。 MICRO 根據項目特徵共同建模評分和標註損失，以引導獲取。它根據預測的嚴重性概率對獲取進行聚類，以選擇多樣的候選者，然後使用滾動估算它們的發現價值。在 WMT20 英德語的實驗中，評分改善了損失重建和嚴重性預測。 MICRO 在四個預算和評分成本設置中實現了最高的平均發現數量，在一個設置中與改編的 MF-ENS 表現相似，而在其他三個設置中則顯著超過所有六個比較政策，包括兩個滾動控制 $(p<.001)$。
